title: Cover parseable non-canonical UUID selectors in focused command recognition
outcome: Focused command recognition rejects parseable non-canonical mailbox UUID selectors while continuing to accept canonical UUID and bounded relay selectors, with behavioral regression coverage.
acceptance: Focused recognition tests exercise uppercase and simple no-hyphen UUID selectors (and representative braced or urn forms) and observe refusal while canonical UUID and bounded relay selector cases remain accepted.
Existing focused recognition and provider/native completion tests stay green.
